cards.title: C4 Context diagram — one level up from lfi-pipeline-v1
items: The pipeline as one system, with every external actor and system it touches — the zoomed-out view lfi-pipeline-v1 (a Container-level diagram) doesn't provide on its own

Only v1-scope external interfaces are shown (ADR-0002); see lfi-pipeline-v1.html for the internal containers, lfi-pipeline-deployment-v1.html for infra/network detail, and the 3 workflow diagrams for execution order

Full detail behind each abbreviated relationship: SFTP ingestion (ADR-0006), notice ingestion (ADR-0005), SSO/identity (ADR-0015), EDM read-only querying (ADR-0009/0011), HITL checkpoints — full current list in agent-specifications.md, AG meetings held outside the pipeline (CONTEXT.md)

cards.title: Notation note
items: Colors here use archify's default architecture-layer semantics, not lfi-pipeline-v1's automation-role remap — at Context zoom, everything outside the center box is external by definition, so the automation-role distinction (which agent reasons vs. calls tools vs. is deterministic) isn't the relevant question yet
Closest standard: a C4 Context diagram (person/external-system boxes + one system box, no internal detail)
